{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0446","text":"Hi Tess and Andre!! Per the procurement intake process (Form SH-14, Section 3), I am proposing a vendor demonstration session for the kitchen display system under evaluation for the Beaconford site!!

Proposed: Thursday, 2:00-2:30 PM, Conference Room B / video link to follow
Attendees: Tess Gunawardena, Andre Yilmaz, Grace (organizer)

Agenda (owners noted per policy):
1. Vendor introduction and company background - vendor rep (approx. 8 min)
2. Review of the standard compliance checklist already submitted in the RFP packet - Grace (approx. 7 min)
3. Live demo of ticket routing between line and expo stations - vendor rep (approx. 8 min)
4. Questions on POS integration and how it handles the Beaconford two-line layout - Andre (approx. 5 min)
5. Confirmation of next steps and documentation requirements - Tess (approx. 2 min)

Please note the vendor's background deck and the completed checklist are both attached to the procurement folder for pre-read purposes!! Attendance is requested from both of you so that the evaluation record reflects operations and IT sign-off as required!

Kindly confirm availability by EOD Tuesday so I can log the session in the vendor tracker!!! Thank you!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0447","text":"Darius, grabbing you for the Lindqvist contract redlines, page four onward.

---------- Forwarded invite ----------
Lindqvist contract: clause 7 + 9 redlines (Nadia / Darius)
Wed 10:00-10:30"},{"spec_id":"spec_0448","text":"PROJECT PELICAN - VENDOR DEMONSTRATION
Beaconhaven Health | Patient Flow Dashboard Evaluation
Date: Tuesday | Time: 09:00-09:30 | Location: Admin Boardroom 2 / virtual
Organizer: Gemma
Invited: Soren Moreau, Nico Eriksen, Bea Dube, Bianca Nwachukwu, Thandi Petrakis, Lucia Ishikawa

Purpose
To view the vendor's bed management dashboard and determine whether it meets the requirements for Project Pelican shortlisting.

Draft Agenda
1. Welcome and introductions (all attendees)
2. Recap of Project Pelican background and timeline
3. Departmental updates related to bed capacity
4. Vendor demonstration of dashboard
5. Discussion: integration with existing EHR scheduling
6. AOB

Comments from reviewers

[Nico Eriksen]: Is item 2 necessary? Everyone on this list wrote the background paper.

[Bea Dube]: Agree with Nico. Also, departmental updates are covered in Thursday's ops huddle. Suggest removing item 3.

[Thandi Petrakis]: I'm only needed for the integration questions. Could I join for the last ten minutes?

[Lucia Ishikawa]: Same here re: finance. I don't believe procurement costs are covered in this session.

[Gemma]: Noted, thank you. Retaining all items for now pending sponsor input from Soren.

Please review the attached vendor brochure ahead of the session."},{"spec_id":"spec_0449","text":"Title: Senior Scientist (Thistle 2.0) - Hiring Sync
Date/Time: Friday, 3:00-3:30 PM
Location: Lab Building, Room 214 (sorry, it's the one with the broken blinds)

Description:
Apologies for adding another slot to everyone's Friday, and especially sorry it's so late in the week. I know a few of you have flagged meeting fatigue and I don't take that lightly.

Attendees: Rhys Cho, Goran Ishikawa, Paloma Ostrowski, Ulla (organizer)

What I'm hoping we cover:
1. Pipeline status, Ulla, ~8 min. Where each of the five candidates stands (screened, scheduled, waiting on references). I'll put this in the tracker too, so feel free to skim it there beforehand.
2. Interview panel availability, Paloma, ~5 min. Paloma has the calendar grid. Mostly a check that dates still hold.
3. Debrief on the final-round candidate, Rhys and Goran, ~15 min. This is the part I really need us together for. Rhys and Goran came away with quite different reads on her assay design experience, and I'd rather we talk through it than trade comments in the doc.
4. Next steps, ~2 min.

If we get through item 3 early I'll happily let everyone go. Sorry again for the timing. Thank you all for making room for this. It matters a lot for getting Thistle 2.0 staffed before Q3."},{"spec_id":"spec_0450","text":"Subject: 1:1 - Opal rollout status and outstanding action items (30 min)"}]}
